protected_outcome: Preserve bounded lifecycle decisions across completion, challenger evaluation, standby retention, emergency failover, recovery and creator-independent regeneration without granting implementation or promotion authority to the validator itself.

screening_policy.note: These values are screening priors only. Promotion still requires survived same-workload evidence, migration/rollback fitness and explicit authority.

protected_rules.small_gain_high_resilience: A small or unproven performance winner may remain STANDBY when a bounded recovery probe passes and resilience value is HIGH; it must not become PRIMARY merely because it is numerically better.
protected_rules.promotion_authority: No FULL or PARTIAL replacement is authorized unless promote authority is AUTHORIZED.
protected_rules.emergency_probe: Emergency failover requires a successful recovery/failover probe.
protected_rules.failure_domain: When the triggering failure domain is material, a fallback requires VERIFIED independence evidence; labels alone are insufficient.
protected_rules.recovery: backup_present alone is insufficient; fresh_restore_test PASS plus canonical_material PASS is required for RECOVERABLE.
protected_rules.phoenix: A Succession Packet without a Phoenix Test is RECOVERABLE at most, not PHOENIX_READY.
protected_rules.unknown_event: An unmodeled trigger reopens BUILD / inner design review rather than inventing a transition.

authority_boundary: Regeneration, comparison and validation do not authorize deployment, promotion, disclosure, spending, submission or other material external action.
